---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an analytical capability, data pipeline enhancement, or model architecture
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature.

### Motivation & Cyber Domain Relevance
Explain why this enhancement is valuable for network intrusion detection, feature engineering, or SOC analytics.

### Proposed Architecture & Implementation
Describe how this feature should integrate with existing packages (`neuralshield.data`, `analysis`, `features`, `visualization`, or `app_pages`).

### Data Science & Security Considerations
- Does this feature introduce potential data leakage?
- Does it require new dependencies (strictly prohibited without governance approval)?
- What evaluation metrics will quantify its efficacy?
